observations.behavior: Documentation metadata: P1.F1.H1 removes several skipped API endpoints and adds four new ones, including VPP subscriptions, device enrollments, and history tables. P1.F2.H1 adds canonical descriptions and column definitions for these new warehouse tables. P1.F3.H1 adds endpoint configuration entries for the same resources.

Added as `volume_purchasing_content` (fan-out over the new `volume_purchasing_locations` table) and `volume_purchasing_subscriptions`.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: the caption string now lists additional supported Jamf Pro API resource types, including Computer Extension Attributes, Mobile Device Extension Attributes, Volume Purchasing Locations, and Device Enrollment Program Instances.
observations.code_quote: The recommended way to connect is an API client: in Jamf Pro go to **Settings > System > API roles and clients**, create an API role with **read** privileges for the objects you want to sync (Computers, Mobile Devices, Buildings, Departments, Categories, Sites, Smart Computer Groups, Static Computer Groups, Smart Mobile Device Groups, Static Mobile Device Groups, Scripts, Packages, Users, Patch Management Software Titles, Patch Policies, Computer Extension Attributes, Mobile Device Extension Attributes, Volume Purchasing Locations, Device Enrollment Program Instances), plus **View MDM command information in Jamf Pro API** for MDM commands, then create an API client with that role and enable it.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies supported ingestion targets for the Jamf Pro warehouse connector, potentially expanding compatibility with customers using these resource types.

observations.behavior: Adds two new parameterized test cases to the scoped probe, covering device enrollment devices and script history endpoints.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression tests for newly supported resource types, supporting the documentation update and connector compatibility.

observations.behavior: Adds a parametrized test suite for paginated fan-out children, including building, category, department, package, script, and volume purchasing content history, and an unpaginated fan-out test for device enrollment devices. Also adds a sample capture configuration test and a guard against unbounded parent lists.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds comprehensive tests for paginated and unpaginated fan-out behavior and sample capture configuration, supporting the implementation of the expanded resource support.
